content.json:
# NexGen Cost Allocation Dashboard
Cost breakdown by environment, resource group, and tag.

content.query:
usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend Environment = tostring(tags['Environment'])
| where isnotempty(Environment)
| summarize Cost = sum(pretaxCost) by Environment
| render barchart
content.title: Cost by Environment (Last 30 Days)

content.query:
usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Cost = sum(pretaxCost) by ResourceGroup
| top 10 by Cost desc
| render barchart
content.title: Top 10 Resource Groups by Cost
